question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Whet your appetite
solution:
The correct answer is **'To want something more'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Whet your appetite' **is **'To want something more'.**
 
• **Whet your appetite: **sharpen one's desire for food/ increase feeling of wanting something. (भोजन की इच्छा को तेज करना / कुछ चाहने की भावना को बढ़ाना।)
 
 
• *Example: a TV program that will **whet people’s appetite** for travel...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To want something more.*
